인터넷이 되면 번역 서버로 그 언어 그대로 번역합니다. 인터넷이 없을 때: When there is internet, the translation server translates into that language. Only when there is no internet is the text shown in another language the listener can read: Nepali is shown in Hindi, Lao in Thai and Mongolian in Russian, and the screen says so, for example "No Nepali model; showing Hindi instead." Uzbek, Khmer, Burmese and Sinhala have no substitute language, so the screen says "This language requires internet."
